title: RENDER — Customs House, the Time Ball

features.name: the ball above the clock tower
features.desc-on-touch: It dropped at one so the ships could set their clocks. A spherical box catching afternoon digital dynamic light, ambient occlusions, chromatic aberrations of emissive materials, volumetric cookies of dust that buffer all day.

features.name: the cyber bushranger heritage tour
features.desc-on-touch: Please remain with the group and allow sufficient room for members of the public to pass. There is nobody else on the footpath. She moves closer.

features.name: a city composed from old photographs
features.desc-on-touch: Caramelised and half-melted, but with enough headroom left to navigate the streets unfettered.

inscription: an old reconstruction of Newcastle still running
